title: SLeeLa parametry binding (version 1.0)
description: A user-owned binding of a SLeeLa LLM or neural net to EITHER a known/supported model (by name) OR a local model (by path). Exactly one source should be given; if a name is unknown and a local_path is present, parametry falls back to the local model.

name.description: A known model name from known-models.json.

local_path.description: A path to the user's local model.

weight_bytes.description: LLM: declared size (2..16 GB envelope advisory).

layer_sizes.description: Neural net: fully-connected layer shape, input through output. Required for a LOCAL neural net.
